import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[0]; g = params[1]
    e = np.exp(-g*t)
    c = np.cos(w*t); s = np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[2] + params[3]*x + params[4]*v + params[5]*v*v + params[6]*np.sin(v)
            + e*(params[7]*c + params[8]*s) + params[9]*x*v)
